evidence_notice: Generated sentinel fixtures only. Local or simulated runs cannot satisfy real-population, provider or customer-evidence gates, and nothing here is an accuracy claim.

external_inputs.input: customer-approved population frame, sampling design and tolerances
blinded second qualified adjudicator or independent authoritative record
one-family query parity in private Slack and the worker UI
external_inputs.owner: Codex lane (Slack and worker-UI query surface)

local_engineering_checks: audit verdict regressions over the hand-checked packs and mutations A-D

worker-side release check of the receipt, read from a worker store it opens itself (refuses non-allowed, stale and superseded receipts, and naive store copies or unrechained log edits; a self-consistent store built or rewritten with the worker's filesystem rights passes with only the unsigned holds)
exposure guard fail-open fixes (PR #219, parallel lane)
redaction: pseudonymised_with_unkeyed_digests_dictionary_attackable: no family id, label, label commitment or verifier identity is copied verbatim, but the fields in unkeyed_digest_fields are unkeyed SHA-256 digests or prefixes that anyone who can guess the input can confirm. No keyed pseudonymisation helper or key custody exists for this output.

release_worker.finding: No release worker on main consumes the OPE-526 receipt. release_gate, release_authority and release_outbox (services/cell-runtime) gate a human release decision on repair runs, take no audit receipt and cannot import the training package. candidate_staging (OPE-545) stages, does not release, and reads a caller-supplied audit_verdict string. comparison_packet (OPE-421, services/cell-runtime) does consume opentour.benchmark-audit-receipt.v1, but checks only that its digest and id are self-consistent and reads verdict, status and bindings from the supplied document; it does not call this check and cannot import the training package.

step2_decision.action: Missing audit, selective corrections or thin critical slices: scope the claim to what was sampled or return insufficient evidence; set a blinded, stratified adjudication plan against the intended population and collect the missing independent cases under the current grant.

triggers.no_independent_customer_label_audit: 0 of 20 runs carry independent customer evidence; all are generated_sentinel

step4_decision_record.change_under_test: No benchmark or label change. This revision adds the run inventory, the worker audit store (identity, hash-chained event log, benchmark state) and the worker-side release check that reads the receipt from that store.
step4_decision_record.hypothesis: The 12-family generated fixture supports only fixture agreement, never customer accuracy. Scoping its claim to that and returning insufficient evidence for any real-population claim, until a blinded, stratified independent label audit of the intended population exists, is the correct disposition. Rescoring identical inputs reproduces the verdict, and every held or invalid population permits no alert.

next_iteration.measured_cause: no independent customer label-audit receipt exists for any eligible run
next_iteration.owner: named customer evidence owner (sampling frame, tolerances, adjudicators)
next_iteration.stop_condition: a blinded, stratified independent audit of the customer-approved frame whose critical strata meet the registered coverage and whose exact upper error is at or below the ceiling; at zero errors that needs 59 independent families per claimed stratum; or the owner declines, which keeps the hold

step3_rerun.fresh_blinded_audit_sample: not_run: no repair was made from prior findings and no independent population exists to sample; a fresh sample needs the customer-approved frame

trade_offs: Holding the real-population claim delays any customer accuracy alert until independent evidence exists; the starter and fixture-agreement views stay available.
The release check refuses or holds every receipt today, because receipts are digest-consistent only, the issuer is unauthenticated and the worker event log is unsigned.

unkeyed_digest_fields.inputs_and_configuration.binding_digests: first 12 hex of each unkeyed binding digest
unkeyed_digest_fields.inputs_and_configuration.preregistration: sha256 of the preregistration (includes the label-authority name), full
unkeyed_digest_fields.receipt.receipt_digest: sha256 of the receipt body, full
